documents.title: Forum Analytics Report
documents.content:
Posting activity in the first two weeks of April was slightly ahead of the comparable period in March, driven largely by the ongoing malaria prevention awareness campaign and a spike in questions about the recent cholera outbreak in neighbouring states. Traffic sources showed no material shift in composition, with direct visits and Google Search continuing to dominate. Mobile devices accounted for roughly four out of five sessions.

---

**2. Active Members**

| Metric | Value | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Active members (30-day window) | 12,500 | Current as of 15 April 2025 |
| Active members (7-day window) | 8,940 | Weekly active count, 9–15 April |
| New registrations (1–15 April) | 1,102 | Net of deletions; 14 accounts removed for spam |
| Reactivated accounts (90+ days inactive) | 236 | Accounts that resumed activity in April |

*The 12,500 figure is the primary membership metric used in the monthly board report. It is computed using the same methodology as previous months: any member with at least one logged action in the trailing 30 days, excluding accounts flagged as automated or duplicate.*

---

| Sub-forum | Posts | New Threads | Avg. Replies per Thread |
